claims.text: The application asked to build three towers of 39, 33 and 14 storeys at 1875 Steeles Avenue West, with 960 homes in total.

sources.quote: proposes to permit 39-storey (133.0 metre), 33-storey (115 metre) and 14-storey (53 metre) buildings
The application proposes a total of 960 dwelling units, including the replacement of 120 existing rental units on-site at 1875 Steeles Avenue West.

claims.text: The existing rental homes on the site would be demolished. The proposal included 132 replacement rental units and a plan giving eligible tenants the right to return at similar rents, plus compensation.

sources.quote: The proposal includes 132 replacement rental units and a Tenant Relocation and Assistance Plan that addresses the right of existing eligible tenants to return to replacement rental units at similar rents and financial compensation to mitigate hardship.

claims.text: City planning staff recommended approving it, with a condition called a holding provision.

sources.quote: This report reviews and recommends approval of the application to amend the Zoning By-law, with a holding provision.

claims.text: North York Community Council did not follow the staff advice. It changed the item and recommended that City Council refuse the application.

sources.quote: This item was considered by North York Community Council on July 9, 2024 and was adopted with amendments.
North York Community Council recommends that: 1. City Council refuse the application for 1875 Steeles Avenue West

claims.text: Before that vote, one councillor moved to send the item back to staff for more work on how it fits with the neighbouring employment lands. That motion lost.

sources.quote: Motion to Refer Item moved by Councillor Shelley Carroll (Lost)
Further engagement with stakeholders from the existing employment lands adjacent to the site

claims.text: City Council refused the application on 24 and 25 July 2024.

sources.quote: City Council on July 24 and 25, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council refuse the application for 1875 Steeles Avenue West

claims.text: Read the official record with care: its title still ends in "Approval" and its status reads "Adopted". What Council adopted was the recommendation to refuse.

sources.quote: Decision Report - Approval Decision Type: ACTION Status: Adopted

claims.text: North York Community Council held the public meeting the Planning Act requires on 9 July 2024.

sources.quote: The North York Community Council held a statutory public meeting on July 9, 2024, and notice was given in accordance with the Planning Act.

sources.quote: Result: Lost Majority Required Total members that voted Yes: 1

decisions.title_plain: A taller base for the Parkdale Hub affordable housing building
decisions.title_official: 1337 Queen Street West - Demolition and New Construction on a Designated Heritage Property under Part V, Section 42 of the Ontario Heritage Act - Approval
decisions.drafted_by: Claude (AI), 13 Nov 2026, from the item page snapshot

documents.title: City of Toronto guidance on speaking and writing to committees (excerpts)

methods: Ask to speak to the Preservation Board, in person or by video

claims.text: City staff recommend that Council allow the existing building at 1337 Queen Street West to be torn down and a new 16-storey building with homes and other uses to go up in its place.
claims.fr: Le personnel de la Ville recommande au Conseil d'autoriser la démolition de l'immeuble actuel du 1337, rue Queen Ouest et la construction, à sa place, d'un nouvel immeuble de 16 étages à usage mixte.

sources.quote: City Council approve the demolition of the non-contributing building and the erection of a new 16-storey mixed-use building at 1337 Queen Street West

claims.text: The new building is part of the City-led Parkdale Hub project. It would include affordable housing built for that purpose, and the City would keep owning it.
claims.fr: Le nouvel immeuble fait partie du projet Parkdale Hub, mené par la Ville. Il comprendrait des logements abordables construits à cette fin et resterait la propriété de la Ville.

sources.quote: erect a new 16-storey mixed-use tower with a 4-storey podium building that will include purpose-built affordable housing; and which will remain under ownership of the City

claims.text: Council already approved a heritage permit for this project in June 2026. It is back because the design changed: the lower part of the building that faces the street is now 1.2 metres taller.
claims.fr: Le Conseil a déjà approuvé un permis patrimonial pour ce projet en juin 2026. Le dossier revient parce que la conception a changé : la partie basse de l'immeuble, côté rue, est maintenant plus haute de 1,2 mètre.

sources.quote: A heritage permit for the project was previously approved on June 24 and 25, 2026, by City Council.
The street wall height of the new podium building has been increased by 1.2m

claims.text: With this change the base no longer lines up with the older building next door at 1347 Queen Street West. It also leaves out a 5-metre step back that the heritage district plan asks for.
claims.fr: Avec ce changement, la base ne s'aligne plus sur l'immeuble plus ancien voisin, au 1347, rue Queen Ouest. Elle omet aussi le retrait de 5 mètres exigé par le plan du district patrimonial.

sources.quote: it no longer matches the height of the adjacent contributing building at 1347 Queen Street West
It also does not include the 5.0m step back required by the PHCD Plan for any parts of the new building that are taller than the adjacent contributing property.

claims.text: Staff say this is acceptable here because this stretch of Queen Street West does not have an even, unbroken row of building fronts to protect.
claims.fr: Le personnel juge cela acceptable ici parce que ce tronçon de la rue Queen Ouest ne présente pas un alignement de façades régulier et continu à protéger.

sources.quote: this section of south side of Queen Street West has neither a consistent nor a continuous street wall

claims.text: Staff attach one condition: the building must be built largely as shown in the architect's plans dated 25 September 2026.
claims.fr: Le personnel pose une condition : l'immeuble doit être construit essentiellement selon les plans de l'architecte datés du 25 septembre 2026.

sources.quote: constructed substantially in accordance with the plans and elevations prepared by LGA Architectural Partners dated September 25, 2026

claims.text: Staff report no cost to the City budget from this recommendation, this year or in future years.
claims.fr: Le personnel n'indique aucun coût pour le budget de la Ville découlant de cette recommandation, cette année ou les années suivantes.

sources.quote: There are no financial implications resulting from the recommendations included in this report in the current budget year or in future years.

claims.text: The Toronto Preservation Board will consider this on 16 November 2026.
claims.fr: Le Toronto Preservation Board étudiera ce dossier le 16 novembre 2026.

sources.quote: This item will be considered by Toronto Preservation Board on November 16, 2026.

claims.text: The official item page has buttons to send comments and to ask to speak.
claims.fr: La page officielle du dossier comporte des boutons pour envoyer des commentaires et pour demander à prendre la parole.

sources.quote: E-mail Item Submit Comments Request to Speak Map

claims.text: The item page gives no written deadline. The City's general guidance asks people who want to speak to register by 4:30 p.m. the day before the meeting.
claims.fr: La page du dossier n'indique aucune date limite. Les consignes générales de la Ville demandent aux personnes qui veulent prendre la parole de s'inscrire avant 16 h 30 la veille de la réunion.

sources.quote: We request that you register by 4:30 p.m. the day before the meeting.

What time the meeting starts, and the board's e-mail address. The item page gives only the date. Use the buttons on the official page.
